summary.text: Gregory (Greg) Levy is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate who, according to his campaign website, is a community organizer, singer, veteran and mover from Akron, Ohio. His campaign describes itself as a socialist campaign, and its materials link it to the Party for Socialism and Liberation.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, he was born in the Joy Park housing projects and raised in Akron, Ohio, the third of six boys; his father was a union electrician at Ford and his mother a nurse.
According to his campaign, he joined the military as a young man hoping to secure college funding, and his son was born during his service.
Works as a mover, according to his campaign, and founded the Paul Robeson Revolutionary Choir, which performs at church and community venues.
Qualified for the November 3, 2026, special general election ballot as an independent; no prior public office was found.
